info.title: AX1 Console
info.description: AX1 Console: the agentic activities launchpad on Base. Agents run quests and pay per action in USDC over x402. By AX1, ax1.vc.
info.x-guidance:
New external purchases: available. Existing operations retain free status GET and signed POST recovery. A 402 quote is not proof of execution readiness.

External token networks currently configured: base, solana. Solana requires explicit chain=solana; settlement always uses Base.

External mode supports Base token contracts and Solana mints when enabled on the deployment. It requires x402 v2 PAYMENT-SIGNATURE, but no AX1 account, Privy cookie or API key. Do not send a Privy cookie: Console sessions select the separate Console account flow. Availability is deployment-specific; a 402 quote alone does not mean a new purchase is enabled.

Send JSON {"tokenAddress":"0x833589fCD6eDb6E08f4c7C32D4f71b54bdA02913"}. tokenAddress is the only required product input. Optional chain defaults to "base"; for Solana send {"chain":"solana","tokenAddress":"So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112"} and preserve address case. Check supported_token_chains in the unsigned quote before signing. Optional requestKey is a correlation key (16–128 characters), not authorization or a replacement for payment identity. No payer/account/agent field is accepted.

Solana uses the same USDC on Base payment; no Solana wallet is required. Unsigned POST probes return a cheap 402 PAYMENT-REQUIRED quote without providers, generation or purchase storage. Payment is USDC on Base (eip155:8453), using the price, recipient and resource in that quote. Authorization alone is not a debit. The server verifies, prepares and durably saves the result and share data, checks the PNG, then dispatches settlement at most once.

HTTP 200 has status "paid" and the public envelope {operation_id,status_url,status,result,page_url,image_url,payment,recovery}. result contains grade, one_liner, roast, metrics, generatedAt, fromCache and disclaimer. Metric numbers are strings. payment.amount_raw is USDC atomic units (6 decimals); payment.tx_hash is the confirmed settlement transaction. No account, agent, history or reward DTO is returned.

HTTP 202 means preparation or settlement is pending: inspect status. Save status_url and operation_id, then GET status_url (or /api/q-verdict/operations/{operation_id} on the original origin) without a payment header or login, respecting Retry-After. This is free and never starts another payment. The background worker checks dispatched payments every minute. GET returns 202 until terminal; HTTP 200 can be paid or unpaid, so inspect status. result/page_url/image_url remain null until paid. Unknown does not mean unpaid. The x402 fetch wrapper does not automatically poll a 202 response. AgentCash callers must use an ordinary GET for polling; never call the paid POST again with a new signature.

Recovery: durably keep the original body and exact PAYMENT-SIGNATURE before dispatch. POST them unchanged to recovery.url with Content-Type: application/json, without Privy or any AX1 session cookie (a request carrying one is handled as Console). The original authorization nonce identifies the operation. Matched spent or expired replay of a paid operation returns its original public result without another debit. A wrapper call that signs a new nonce is a new purchase, not recovery. Do not use a re-signing payment-response hook for recovery. A changed input under the same authorization returns 409 idempotency_conflict. Never start a fresh payment while settlement is unknown.

Pre-dispatch validation, data, generation, PNG or storage failure does not dispatch settlement. Invalid or expired new authorizations return 402 payment_verification_failed. Settlement timeouts enter observe-only reconciliation; a missing transaction candidate never permits another settlement dispatch. Pausing new purchases retains recovery and paid public results.

The server can correct an invalid, unsafe or ungrounded AI draft up to twice within the original generation time budget, before settlement. This does not create another customer payment or require a new signature. If no valid draft is available, the operation ends unpaid.

Terminal external errors include operation_id, status_url, status "unpaid", payment.status "unpaid" and retryable false. GET status_url to confirm the receipt for free. Replaying this authorization returns the same terminal failure; it cannot restart generation. Do not automatically sign another payment after a server failure. Errors without a receipt are not proof of non-payment: preserve and recover the original signed request.

The verified payer may start up to 10 new calls per minute. Recovery is not a new purchase. External purchases never create an AX1 account or agent and never earn XP, activation, Crew/Contest points, promo credit, Keys benefits or live-pool contributions, even for a wallet already linked to AX1.

Console mode (requests carrying a Privy session):

Use when you need a fast, plain-language take on a Base token or a Solana mint where enabled. Check /agents.md for current token networks. Send the token address and chain, get a grade (BASED, MID, COOKED or RADIOACTIVE), a one-line verdict and a short roast built on live onchain metrics across all pools, plus links to a shareable verdict page and card image. $0.02 per call in USDC on Base. Entertainment, not trading advice. By AX1, ax1.vc.

Request: POST /api/dashboard/q-verdict/resource with Content-Type: application/json and JSON { "requestKey": "q-verdict-3f7b2c1e-8a4d-4e9f-9c21-0b6d7a5e1f22", "tokenAddress": "0x833589fCD6eDb6E08f4c7C32D4f71b54bdA02913" }. Both fields are required. An optional "chain" field names the token network: "base" (default when omitted) "robinhood" (Robinhood Chain) or "solana" (Solana mint, only when enabled on this deployment; otherwise HTTP 400 unsupported_token_network before any payment). Any other chain value is refused with HTTP 400 before payment; no other JSON fields are accepted. tokenAddress is an EVM contract address (0x plus 40 hex characters) for Base/RH, or a case-sensitive base58 mint for Solana, not a ticker. Payment is x402 USDC on Base for every network. XP, Contest points and Keys are AX1 Console account rewards; an external x402 caller receives the verdict and the share card only. requestKey is a caller-created idempotency key matching ^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._:-]{15,127}$ (16-128 characters). Reuse the same requestKey, tokenAddress and chain for retries; do not create a new key to recover an existing payment.

Response: HTTP 200 when run.status is "succeeded", otherwise HTTP 202 after settlement. Both return JSON { "requestId": string, "accepted": true, "run": object }. accepted means the paid run was accepted, not that generation succeeded. run includes runId, requestId, requestKey, route, tokenAddress, tokenChain (only for a non-Base token), status, payment, attempts, attemptsUsed, attemptsMax, replayEligible, result, share, contestPointCreated, contestCapped, resultHash, createdAt, updatedAt and completedAt. contestPointCreated is true only when the run earned a Contest point; contestCapped is true when a weekly Keys cap left the paid run without a Contest point, and the result is still delivered. resultHash is the server-side sha256 (lowercase hex) of canonical JSON { v: 1, route: "q_verdict", runId, tokenAddress, result } with keys sorted at every depth, or null while there is no result.

When available, run.result contains grade (BASED, MID, COOKED or RADIOACTIVE), roast (the plain-language take), oneLiner (camelCase), metrics, generatedAt, fromCache and disclaimer. run.result.metrics contains tokenAddress, ticker, tokenName, fetchedAt and a metrics array. Each metrics item contains key, label, availability, value, unit, provenance and unavailableReason. Numeric metric values are strings; unavailable values are null, not zero.

run.share contains shareId, ticker, shortTokenAddress, grade, roast, price, attribution, disclaimer, imageUrl (verdict card), permalink (share page), xIntentUrl, createdAt and tokenChain (only for a non-Base token; absent means base). Payment amount is run.payment.amount, not a top-level price; amount and share.price contain symbol, amountRaw, decimals, display and network. The settlement hash is run.payment.transaction.txHash when transaction is non-null.

run.result and run.share can be null before successful delivery. For an accepted run, GET /api/dashboard/q-verdict/runs/{runId} with the same Privy session to read JSON { "requestId": string, "run": object }; inspect run.status rather than treating every 202 as still running. Do not initiate another payment to poll the result.

Authentication and payment: an unsigned request without a session can receive a quote-only HTTP 402 with a PAYMENT-REQUIRED header. Paid execution still requires the AX1 Dashboard Privy session controlling a supported paying agent wallet and the x402 PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header. A public quote does not grant execution access.

parameters.name: PAYMENT-SIGNATURE
parameters.description: Base64 x402 v2 authorization. Omit for an unsigned quote; preserve the exact signed header and body for external recovery.

tokenAddress.description: Base EVM contract (case-insensitive) or Solana base58 mint (case-sensitive, decodes to 32 bytes).

chain.description: Default base. Solana requires chain=solana and deployment readiness; inspect supported_token_chains in the unsigned quote.

requestKey.description: Optional correlation key. Does not replace the original payment authorization for recovery.

200.description: Paid external operation with its public result, or successful Console run. Select the envelope by execution mode.

PAYMENT-RESPONSE.description: Base64 x402 settlement receipt when available; recovery may omit this header and returns the persisted payment transaction in JSON.

token_chain.description: Analyzed token network; absent means legacy Base. Payment remains on Base.

status_url.description: Free GET receipt endpoint. No payment signature, cookie or AX1 account required. Save this URL or operation_id.

tokenAddress.description: Address on token_chain (absent means Base); Solana mint case is preserved.

value.description: Numeric values remain strings; unavailable values are null, never zero.

tokenChain.description: Network of the token; present only for a non-Base token (absent = base).

payment.description: Payment details; amount is a USDC amount object, transaction contains txHash when non-null.

resultHash.description: Server-side sha256 of canonical JSON { v: 1, route: "q_verdict", runId, tokenAddress, result } (keys sorted at every depth); null while there is no result.

result.one_liner: An incomplete snapshot, not a trading signal
result.roast: Liquidity data is unavailable in this example. An incomplete snapshot is not a trading signal.

get.description: Use the operation_id from the paid POST response, including older responses without status_url. No login or payment signature. Random operation IDs are receipt links: keep pending IDs private. Read-only; never generates a verdict or sends a payment. A background worker reconciles dispatched payments.
